AIPPT Mindshow Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Mindshow/AIPPT integration skill.
- Provides CLI-based workflow to generate PPT via AIPPT API using keywords or uploaded files.
- Supports outlining, Markdown content generation, PPT task creation, progress polling, and template management.
- Documents the required configuration (token, endpoint) and usage flows for both keyword- and file-based PPT generation.
- Includes clear command examples, SSE handling details, and output conventions for all key endpoints.
